listing.sub: The school-morning checklist
listing.desc: A daily checklist for getting out the door ready for school: medicine, vitamins, school bag, water and whatever else the morning needs. Make a different list for different days (a weekend list, or one for Mon/Thu and another for Tue/Fri), add or remove items any time, snap a photo of each item so it's easy to recognize, set optional timers and reminders, and when every box is checked a random full-screen dance celebrates. No end date. Everything stays on the phone unless you sign in with Google to back up your lists, streak and pictures.
feats: A photo for every item
Tap the camera next to an item to take its picture. Sign in with Google to keep them safe.
Timers and reminders
A countdown on any item, reminders at the times you pick, and a calendar file for real alarms.
Full-screen celebration
Finish the list and a random dance plays: disco, the floss, the twerk, the Griddy and more. Add your own GIFs too.

listing.sub: Where the photographer stood
listing.access: Open to read, Google sign-in to share
listing.desc: A companion to your photo gallery. Every photo gets a pin on a map at the exact spot it was shot from, and a blueprint-style sheet of how: standing, kneeling, laying down, crouching, sitting, on a tripod or a monopod; the camera, lens, focal length, aperture, shutter, ISO and the direction the camera faced; and below it the story of how the shot came together. A photo's own notes (EXIF) fill the sheet in. Sheets stay on your phone until you sign in and share them; a link to the Instagram post ties the two together.
feats: A pin where you stood
Tap the map, or let the photo's own GPS drop it. Aim the field-of-view wedge where the lens pointed.
Blueprint sheet
Title block, stance drawing with the camera height, gear and exposure table, mini map and the story.
Gallery and map
Browse everyone's shared sheets as a contact sheet or as pins. Yours work offline.
